description: Feel inspired by titanium's lightweight, bright, and mesmerising qualities with the T Line - 4-speed from Brompton. With this sleek bike, you can experience the city in an immersive way. By choosing this lightweight yet powerful model, you can keep focusing on your surroundings as your bike does all the work for you. From noticing the change in a breeze that signifies the entrance to a city to the unique sounds you only hear when riding the T Line - 4-speed lets you embrace urban life completely. To get you around the city, this bike includes 4-speed gears, which improve control and agility. Expertly engineered, this lightweight frame weighs 37% less than steel equivalents, improving the gearing elements and on-road positioning.Being able to say yes to every opportunity is made possible by the simple folding system, which means you can transition from two wheels to two feet in just 20 seconds. Also light to carry, you can move around with ease in a much better way than compared to traditional bikes.Precision engineering means you can tackle everything that comes your way. By feeling empowered thanks to the versatile T Line - 4-speed, a more energetic and active way of life awaits you! Brompton can provide a reliable transport method; it's up to you to find your next adventure. Whichever horizon you choose to explore, with the T Line - 4-speed by your side, a positive experience is guaranteed.
